title: IdentityReactivatedEvent
description: Emitted when a suspended canonical identity is reactivated (ADR-0016 §8 'Suspension SHOULD be reversible'). Reactivation SHALL be explicit (ADR-0016 §128): this event is that explicit record, and its previous_status of SUSPENDED-only means a disabled or archived identity cannot silently reactivate through this event -- ADR-0016 §132 treats archived-identity reactivation as exceptional and out of this event's scope. This is the event envelope's `data` payload — see asyncapi.yaml for how it composes with contracts/events/v1/envelope.schema.json.

actor.description: Who performed the action (system or human ID).
